view.description: The screen's address slug (data-sources, assets, agentic_process). The join key with here and with a view target.

label.description: What the screen is called, in English.

aliases.description: Other words a person uses for it.

pointer.description: Whether an address names something inside the screen.

pointer_form.description: How that pointer is written, e.g. <id> or <id>/stream_inbox.

provides.description: Context the screen really sets, beyond the project. Here keeps only these.

opens.description: Entity types whose id can be the pointer (a project's graph, a session's transcript).

subplaces.description: Tabs and filters worth naming as places of their own.
